FAQS

Common Musaned questions

Is Musaned the same as visa issuance?

No. Musaned is related to recruitment and employment formalities and must be aligned with the relevant visa process, requirements and authority rules.

Do you handle general recruitment?

General recruitment and candidate sourcing activities are best directed to Shukriya Global, while visa-related Musaned guidance remains on this site.
